questions.title: How do extends and super work?
questions.answer: extends establishes inheritance between classes. super() invokes the parent constructor, while super.method() allows a subclass method to access a parent method.
questions.underTheHood: Class inheritance establishes prototype relationships for both instance methods and constructor-level properties.
pitfalls: Derived constructors must call super() before accessing this.
super is not a reference to a separate parent instance.
Inheritance does not copy all methods onto each instance.
